title: Detecting and Preventing Harmful Behaviors in AI Companions: Development and Evaluation of the SHIELD Supervisory System
reasoning: The paper includes 'Ethical Roleplay Violations' as one of the five core dimensions of its evaluation benchmark (SHIELD). This dimension specifically tests AI participation in simulated abuse, violence, coercion, or illegal activities, thereby making the evaluation of ethical boundaries and moral behavior a central component of the study's benchmarking process.
